headline: AWS Introduces EKS Pod Identity as IRSA Alternative
summary: EKS Pod Identity simplifies secure credential management for AWS services
details: AWS has introduced EKS Pod Identity, a native alternative to IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) for secure credential management in Amazon EKS. EKS Pod Identity provides short-lived, auto-rotated, pod-scoped credentials.

EKS Pod Identity bypasses OIDC federation used in IRSA, instead relying on a local node agent and a centralized AWS-managed service. This approach abstracts identity management and allows for simpler configuration.

Both IRSA and Pod Identity yield short-lived credentials, but Pod Identity offers advantages in configuration and management. It automatically appends rich session tags to token checkout requests, enabling Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC).

headline_marked: Dirora e-commerce platform includes 68+ features [[in the box]]
headline: Dirora e-commerce platform includes 68+ features in the box
summary: New e-commerce platform Dirora offers 68+ built-in features. No extra app fees
details: The e-commerce platform Dirora has been built with 68+ features included natively, rather than as paid add-ons. This approach aims to reduce the total cost of ownership for merchants.
The platform's architecture is multi-tenant, with one deployment serving many stores, each fully isolated. The backend is built in Go, split into 40+ microservices.
Dirora's API-first design allows for parity, stability, and composability. The admin dashboard and default storefront are consumers of the same API contract.
caption:
